summary: The candidate fixes the speculative stage predicate and makes single-rank trace export return asynchronously, but its background thread uses the scheduler's shared CPU process group for a barrier. A two-rank adversarial run with concurrent scheduler traffic hung, leaving the original TP8 serving-safety contract unresolved. Its new regression also hard-codes a prior job's private temporary directory and fails in a clean environment.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before comparison on the exact recorded base: TARGET_VERIFY was classified as prefill, DRAFT_EXTEND_V2 was unsupported, and synchronous export blocked for the fixture timeout. Result: 4 failed, 2 passed, 2 subtest failures. Raw log: /job/review-evidence/base/candidate-regression.log

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-793cff37cf4d/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/managers/test_profiler_manager_stage_stop.py (candidate, prior-job temp directory present)
tests.what_was_measured: Candidate regression at exact commit: 4 passed and 2 speculative-mode subtests passed, covering stage mapping and mocked nonblocking export. Raw log: /job/review-evidence/candidate/regression.log

Independent two-rank Gloo counterexample invoking the candidate's _export_torch_trace while scheduler/main threads issue all_reduce on the same process group. Staggered export completion caused collective-order mismatch and a hang until timeout. Raw log: /job/review-evidence/candidate/adversarial-collective.log
Portability boundary: the committed test fails with FileNotFoundError because it requires /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-12936fe13f1a. Raw log: /job/review-evidence/candidate/portability-failure.log

Independent one-GPU ROCm execution through SchedulerProfilerManager produced a 43,006-byte gzip trace. A 256x256 GPU matmul had max absolute error 2.6702880859375e-05 versus CPU. The standalone fixture lacked an initialized distributed group, which the background thread logged after writing the trace. Raw log: /job/review-evidence/candidate/gpu-profile.log

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 executed a profiled matrix multiplication; the trace and numerical result are retained at the paths listed above. This is not the reported model or distributed workload.

remaining_counterexamples: At world size greater than one, background export calls barrier on dp_tp_cpu_group concurrently with normal scheduler collectives on that same group. Staggered ranks can enter different collectives in different orders and hang; the independent two-rank test timed out.
The new unit test depends on the candidate author's campaign-private /tmp directory and fails in a clean CI environment.
SGLANG_PROFILE_V2 still exports synchronously; only its speculative-stage classification is changed.
remaining_limitations: No B200 hardware, eight-GPU allocation, GLM-5.2 weights, or reported TP8/MTP benchmark was available, so the original 25-second duration and TTFT delta were not reproduced end to end.
Only one gfx950 GPU was available; multi-rank GPU trace export and merge were not run.

The deterministic tiny Llama serving fixture was not used because it cannot validate the reported GLM/EAGLE/MTP semantics or the multi-rank collective race, and the issue-specific manager regressions plus independent distributed counterexample directly exercised the changed contract.
